fact: The DSTI says its public Innovation Fund has supported 12 venture capital firms and around 96 technology investment opportunities and enterprises, giving catalytic risk capital to early-stage startups and tech-enabled SMEs.

The SA SME Fund, the science department's Technology Innovation Agency and E Squared launched a R300 million Seed Fund of Funds on 1 October 2024 to back at least 50 technology startups, with Innovation Fund support; no investment is named.
